question: In which of the following cities is the principal bench of the National Company Law Tribunal located?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Principal Bench of the National Company Law Tribunal is located in **Ne****w Delhi.**
 
• Shri Ramalingam Sudhakar is the President of National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi.
 
• NCLT is a judicial authority incorporated for **dealing with corporate disputes that are of civil nature arising under the Companies Act**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Company Law Tribunal is a Quasi-judicial body in India.
 
• It adjudicates issues relating to Indian companies.
 
• The Central Government of India has constituted National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) under section 408 of the Companies Act of the year 2013.
